tools.name: pubchem_search_compounds
tools.description: Search PubChem for chemical compounds by identifier (name, SMILES, or InChIKey, batched up to 25), molecular formula in Hill notation, substructure or superstructure containment, or 2D Tanimoto similarity. Optionally hydrate results with properties to avoid a follow-up pubchem_get_compound_details call.

params.name: query
params.description: Required for substructure/superstructure/similarity searches. A SMILES string (e.g. "CC(=O)O") or PubChem CID as a string (e.g. "2244").

params.name: formula
params.description: Required for formula search. Molecular formula in Hill notation (e.g. "C6H12O6", "CaH2O2").

params.name: queryType
params.description: Required for structure/similarity searches. Format of the query: "smiles" or "cid".

params.name: threshold
params.description: Similarity search only. Minimum Tanimoto similarity (70-100). 90+ for close analogs, 70-80 for scaffold hops. Default: 90.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum CIDs to return (1-200). Default: 20.

params.name: properties
params.description: Optional: fetch these properties for each result, avoiding a follow-up details call. E.g. ["MolecularFormula", "MolecularWeight", "CanonicalSMILES"].

params.name: searchType
params.description: Search strategy. "identifier": name/SMILES/InChIKey lookup. "formula": molecular formula. "substructure": find compounds containing the query as a substructure. "superstructure": find compounds that a

params.name: identifiers
params.description: Required for identifier search. Array of identifiers to resolve (1-25). Examples: ["aspirin", "ibuprofen"] for name, ["CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O"] for SMILES, ["BSYNRYMUTXBXSQ-UHFFFAOYSA-N"] for inchik

params.name: identifierType
params.description: Required for identifier search. Type of chemical identifier: "name", "smiles", or "inchikey".

params.name: allowOtherElements
params.description: Formula search only. When true, includes compounds with additional elements beyond the formula.

tools.name: pubchem_get_compound_details
tools.description: Get detailed compound information by CID. Returns physicochemical properties (molecular weight, SMILES, InChIKey, XLogP, TPSA, etc.), optionally with a textual description (pharmacology, mechanism, therapeutic use), all known synonyms, drug-likeness assessment (Lipinski/Veber rules), and/or pharmacological classification (FDA classes, MeSH classes, ATC codes). Efficiently batches up to 100 CIDs.

params.name: cids
params.description: PubChem Compound IDs to fetch (1-100). Batched efficiently. Resolve from names/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

params.name: properties
params.description: Properties to retrieve. Defaults to a core set: MolecularFormula, MolecularWeight, IUPACName, CanonicalSMILES, IsomericSMILES, InChIKey, XLogP, TPSA, HBondDonorCount, HBondAcceptorCount, RotatableBond

params.name: maxSynonyms
params.description: Max synonyms returned per compound (1-100). PubChem lists hundreds for common drugs; capped to keep the response focused. Default: 20.

params.name: includeSynonyms
params.description: Fetch all known names and synonyms (trade names, systematic names, registry numbers). One API call per CID — slower than the property batch for large CID lists.

params.name: maxDescriptions
params.description: Max number of distinct description entries per compound (1-20). PubChem returns near-duplicate summaries from many depositors; we dedup and cap to keep responses focused. Default: 3.

params.name: includeDescription
params.description: Include textual descriptions (pharmacology, mechanism, therapeutic use) attributed by source. Well-studied compounds have many overlapping summaries — capped via maxDescriptions. Fetched only for the

params.name: includeDrugLikeness
params.description: Compute drug-likeness assessment: Lipinski Rule of Five (MW, XLogP, HBD, HBA) and Veber rules (TPSA, rotatable bonds). No extra API calls — computed from properties.

params.name: includeClassification
params.description: Include pharmacological classification: FDA Established Pharmacologic Classes, mechanisms of action, MeSH classes, and ATC codes. Fetched only for the first 10 CIDs in the batch; remaining CIDs return

tools.name: pubchem_get_compound_image
tools.description: Fetch a 2D structure diagram (PNG image) for a compound by CID.

params.name: cid
params.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

params.name: size
params.description: Image size: "small" (100x100) or "large" (300x300). Default: "large".

tools.name: pubchem_get_compound_3d_structure
tools.description: Get a compound's default 3D conformer — atomic coordinates and bonds — for one CID. format="json" (default) returns parsed atoms and bonds the model can reason over directly; format="sdf" returns the raw V2000 SDF text for passthrough to docking, rendering, or conformer tools. Optionally lists alternate conformer IDs. Not every compound has computed 3D coordinates (large molecules, mixtures, and some salts do not).

params.name: cid
params.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format. "json" (default) returns parsed atoms and bonds. "sdf" returns the raw V2000 SDF text for passthrough to other tools.

params.name: maxAtoms
params.description: Cap the atoms returned in the format="json" preview. atomCount always reports the full total; omitted rows are disclosed via the truncated/shownAtoms enrichment. Defaults to the first 200 atoms.

params.name: maxBonds
params.description: Cap the bonds returned in the format="json" preview. bondCount always reports the full total; omitted rows are disclosed via the truncated/shownBonds enrichment. Defaults to the first 200 bonds.

params.name: includeRawSdf
params.description: For format="sdf", return the complete raw V2000 SDF even when it exceeds the safe line cap. Default false: an SDF longer than 500 lines is line-capped with disclosure. No effect when format="json".

params.name: includeAlternateConformerIds
params.description: List the IDs of additional computed conformers beyond the default. Adds one extra API call. Default: false.

tools.name: pubchem_get_compound_xrefs
tools.description: Get external database cross-references for a compound: PubMed citations, patent IDs, gene/protein associations, registry numbers, and taxonomy IDs. Results are capped per type with total counts reported.

params.name: cid
params.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

params.name: xrefTypes
params.description: Cross-reference types to retrieve. String IDs: RegistryID (DSSTox/EPA registry numbers), RN (CAS numbers), PatentID. Numeric IDs: PubMedID, GeneID (NCBI Gene), ProteinGI (legacy NCBI Protein GI), Taxo

params.name: maxPerType
params.description: Max IDs to return per xref type (1-500). A compound may have thousands of PubMed references. Total count always reported. Default: 50.

tools.name: pubchem_get_compound_safety
tools.description: Get GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard classification and safety data for one or more compounds by CID. Returns signal word, pictograms, hazard statements (H-codes), and precautionary statements (P-codes) per compound. Data sourced from PubChem depositors — source attribution included.

params.name: cids
params.description: PubChem Compound IDs to fetch safety data for (1-25). Resolve from names/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

tools.name: pubchem_get_bioactivity
tools.description: Get a compound's bioactivity profile: which assays tested it, activity outcomes (Active/Inactive/Inconclusive), target identifiers (NCBI Gene ID, UniProt/GenBank accession), and quantitative values (IC50, EC50, Ki, etc.). Filter by outcome and/or a specific molecular target (NCBI Gene ID or protein accession) to focus the profile — e.g. "is this compound active against target T?".

params.name: cid
params.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Max assay results to return (1-100). Well-studied compounds have thousands of records. Default: 20.

params.name: targetGeneId
params.description: Filter to assays against this NCBI Gene ID. Obtain Gene IDs from pubchem_search_assays or the targetGeneId field of an unfiltered result here. Combine with outcomeFilter="active" to answer "is this co

params.name: outcomeFilter
params.description: Filter by activity outcome. "active" shows only assays where the compound showed activity — most useful for understanding biological profile. Default: "all".

params.name: targetAccession
params.description: Filter to assays against this target protein accession (UniProt/GenBank), e.g. "P35354". Obtain accessions from pubchem_search_assays or the targetAccession field of an unfiltered result here.

tools.name: pubchem_get_compound_interactions
tools.description: Get a compound's interaction data: drug-drug interactions (DrugBank), drug-food interactions, and chemical-target interactions (binding/activity from BindingDB, ChEMBL, and others). Each entry carries its originating source. Richest for approved drugs; many compounds have no deposited interaction records.

params.name: cid
params.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

params.name: kinds
params.description: Interaction kinds to fetch. "drug-drug" (interactions with other drugs), "drug-food" (dietary interactions), "target" (binding/activity against molecular targets). Default: ["drug-drug"].

params.name: maxEntries
params.description: Max entries per kind (1-50). Well-studied drugs have a long tail of interactions. Default: 10.

tools.name: pubchem_search_assays
tools.description: Find PubChem bioassays associated with a biological target. Search by gene symbol (e.g. "EGFR"), protein name, NCBI Gene ID, or UniProt accession. Returns assay IDs (AIDs) which can be explored further with pubchem_get_summary.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Max AIDs to return (1-200). Popular targets may have thousands of assays. Default: 50.

params.name: targetType
params.description: Target identifier type. "genesymbol" and "proteinname" accept text names. "geneid" accepts NCBI Gene IDs. "proteinaccession" accepts UniProt accessions.

params.name: targetQuery
params.description: Target identifier. Examples: "EGFR" (genesymbol), "Epidermal growth factor receptor" (proteinname), "1956" (geneid), "P00533" (proteinaccession).

tools.name: pubchem_get_summary
tools.description: Get descriptive summaries for PubChem entities by ID. Supports assays (AID), genes (Gene ID), proteins (UniProt accession), and taxonomy (Tax ID). Up to 10 per call.

params.name: entityType
params.description: Entity type. Determines ID format and returned fields.

params.name: identifiers
params.description: Entity identifiers (1-10). Type depends on entityType: - assay: AID (number), e.g. [1000] - gene: Gene ID (number), e.g. [1956] - protein: UniProt accession (string), e.g. ["P00533"] - taxonomy: Tax I
